doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: Recording with Joe Liggins and the band personnel
summary: He made all of Liggins's records and lists the six men who played on them.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Did you record with Joe Liggins? Yeah.
Oh, I made all the records with him.
Yeah. Who else was with Joe Liggins on these recording dates? Or did you use many people like this?
No, we only used the same men.

Pepe Prince on the drum. Willie Jackson on the baritone alto. James Jackson on the tenor. Eddie Davis on bass. And myself and Joe Liggins. That's all. Oh, yeah. I made them all. All the original ones. Oh, yeah. When did you make your first recording date? Oh, yeah. 1925 in Chicago. 1925? In which band?
